title: SafeSelect command gallery
intro: A visual tour of the CLI, grouped by the job each command helps you finish.

groups.title: Import connections
groups.description: Bring an existing DBeaver, Docker Compose or MongoDB Compass connection into the project.

commands.purpose: Import a DBeaver export into .safeselect/.
commands.caption: The importer keeps the connection shape while leaving passwords outside project files.

commands.purpose: Discover PostgreSQL services from Docker Compose.
commands.caption: Compose discovery turns an existing local service into a project environment.

commands.purpose: Import MongoDB Compass connections.
commands.caption: Compass imports preserve MongoDB connection details without exposing credentials.

groups.title: Prepare the project
groups.description: Validate local policy, install drivers and connect an AI client without repeating configuration flags.

commands.purpose: Validate, inspect and maintain project configuration.
commands.caption: Configuration show reports a safe, redacted policy summary before the server starts.

commands.purpose: Register and verify JDBC drivers.
commands.caption: The driver registry shows the vendor and local verified artifact.

commands.purpose: Detect clients and install their MCP entry.
commands.caption: Detection lists available clients before an explicit project-scoped MCP install.

groups.title: Verify and diagnose
groups.description: Check the complete path from project policy to the database, then inspect the effective PostgreSQL posture.

commands.purpose: Test configuration, secrets, tunnels, sidecar and backend connectivity.
commands.caption: Checks follow convention and inspect every environment unless one is selected deliberately.

commands.purpose: Print concise findings with stable diagnostic codes.
commands.caption: Doctor turns a failed connection into a short next action instead of a log wall.

commands.purpose: Inspect the effective PostgreSQL security posture.
commands.caption: Posture shows the effective read-only policy, limits and database posture before agent use.

groups.title: Manage a connection
groups.description: Start the local MCP server or exercise the temporary connection lifecycle directly.

commands.purpose: Start the local MCP server for a project environment.
commands.caption: The server speaks local stdio: the MCP initialize response exposes SafeSelect capabilities, not a network listener.

commands.purpose: Test a temporary JDBC connection.
commands.caption: Connect verifies the temporary JDBC sidecar against the live fixture without taking over an active MCP session.

commands.purpose: Close a temporary JDBC connection.
commands.caption: Disconnect cleanly closes the temporary JDBC sidecar and reports the completed lifecycle step.

commands.purpose: Restart the sidecar and verify connectivity.
commands.caption: Reconnect restarts the sidecar and verifies the live fixture instead of hiding a stale database.

groups.title: Explore SQL: discover, inspect and diagnose
groups.description: Discover tables and columns through MCP, run bounded SQL separately, and inspect read-only maintenance evidence.

commands.purpose: Discover PostgreSQL tables through MCP.
commands.caption: Real MCP response, formatted as a table: five synthetic relations in public. Discover exact names before inspecting columns.

commands.purpose: Inspect column names, types and nullability through MCP.
commands.caption: Real MCP response, formatted as a table: eight columns including UUID, JSONB and a timestamp range. No data rows are queried.

commands.purpose: Execute one bounded read-only SQL statement and display its results.
commands.example: safeselect query --sql "SELECT order_id, status, subtotal FROM public.demo_orders WHERE status = 'paid' LIMIT 3"
commands.caption: The bounded SQL request returns three synthetic fixture rows with row and byte counts; writes remain rejected.

commands.purpose: Inspect ANALYZE and VACUUM signals without running maintenance.
commands.caption: Real MCP response excerpt: all five fixture tables are below maintenance thresholds. This read-only diagnostic never executes ANALYZE or VACUUM; review the evidence with a DBA.

groups.title: Explore NoSQL
groups.description: Follow MongoDB discovery from databases to bounded documents, with sampled schema inference before reads.

commands.purpose: Discover MongoDB databases through MCP.
commands.caption: Real MCP response: the isolated demo exposes one allowed database. Choose it before discovering collections.

commands.purpose: Discover collections in an allowed MongoDB database.
commands.caption: Real MCP response: four synthetic collections are listed without reading documents.

commands.purpose: Infer frequent fields and types from a bounded MongoDB sample.
commands.caption: Real MCP response: sampled fields and observed types guide the next bounded read; inference is explicitly non-exhaustive.

commands.purpose: Read bounded MongoDB documents with an explicit filter.
commands.caption: Real MCP response: three paid orders, 994 bytes, returned in 7ms. The filter and limit keep the read bounded.
